customManagers.description: ruff pins in CI workflows (uvx form)

packageRules.description: Keep the pre-commit hook and the CI pin on the same ruff version
GitHub Actions used in CI workflows (#708): one grouped PR on the same Monday schedule

Defer Python upgrades in ci.yml: the pytest job segfaults under 3.14 (openstudio extension modules loaded at crash; PR #1154 run 39189032104, 2026-10-19) and under 3.15 (openstudio 3.11.0 bindings segfault, PR #966 CI evidence, 2026-10-14). One-interpreter rule: ci.yml stays 3.12 until a coordinated move with fresh wheels. Non-OpenStudio workflows (sim-smoke, archcad-smoke, already on 3.15) are unaffected.
